news.title: Wall Street braced for a private credit meltdown. The risk of one is rising
news.description: Private credit is expected to grow from $3.4 trillion in 2025 to an estimated $4.9 trillion by 2029. Wall Street is starting to raise alarms about the risks.

news.title: Sen. Warren blasts CFPB director for undermining Trump's credit card affordability push
news.description: Sen. Elizabeth Warren seized on contradictions within the Trump administration when it comes to his push to make credit cards more affordable for Americans.

news.title: Trump's push for Greenland mineral rights could block China's access to rare earths
news.description: Greenland has the eighth-largest rare earth reserves in the world at 1.5 million metric tons, according to 2024 data from the U.S. Geological Survey.
